claim_tested: For nonzero a,b<2^W, if Phi^t(a) and Phi^t(b) have the same bit at c+t for every 0<=t<=2W, then a and b have the same bit length. Here Phi(x)=x XOR((x<<1) OR(x<<2)) and 0<=c<W.
motivation: Post-hoc final audit of the proposed 2W edge bound across all observer placements. This reduces maximum width from18, retaining the same relative time bound. No wider or longer follow-up census in this block.
decision: Any unequal-edge collision refutes the quantitative bound only, not infinite EdgeObservable. A finite successful census is not evidence of a proof or prize solution.
